source.document_id: ISO 16750-2:2012(E), fourth edition 2012-11-01, §4.6.4.2.3, Figure 9 / Table 6, printed pp. 12–13; §4.6.4.2.2, Figure 8 / Table 5, printed pp. 11–12

note: HW-FR-004 source correction from PR #39 review. Numeric facts transcribed from the publicly mirrored standard using the document reader; raw PDF bytes could not be downloaded in the sandbox and are not retained, so no PDF digest is claimed. No new physical part or qualification result is created. The old ISO 7637-2:2011 §5.6.2 Table 11 attribution and 40 V level were incorrect for this normative 12 V Test B baseline. H-06 (issue #49, retrieved and verified against the same mirror on 2026-09-21): added the pulse5a block for ISO 16750-2:2012 §4.6.4.2.2 'Test A – without centralized load dump suppression', Figure 8 / Table 5, printed pp. 11–12. Citation disposition: the H-06 issue body cited '§4.6.4.2.2 / Table 6' for pulse 5a; normative confirmation shows the Test A parameters are tabulated in Table 5 (Table 6 belongs to Test B), so Table 5 is cited here. The pulse5a block carries shape_qualification_pending: true referencing issue #41: the numeric ranges are transcribed facts, the reduced fixture waveform shape is not qualified against Figure 8. Figure 8 measurement definitions transcribed where available: t_r is the rising slope reaching 0.9(Us−UA)+UA and t_d the pulse duration ending at 0.1(Us−UA)+UA, with UA the supply voltage for generator in operation per ISO 16750-1. Facts not transcribable from the source (exact generator decay shape between the Figure 8 measurement points, unclamped-source topology behavior, §4.6.4.3 functional-status outcome) are recorded as absent in the fixture's not-covered lists, not guessed.
